title: Concept: Object injection via Marshal.load in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, Marshal.load decodes a byte string into live objects. Ruby honours the class names embedded in the stream and invokes hooks during reconstruction, so an attacker who controls the bytes chooses which code runs. Session cookies, queue messages and cached fragments are the common carriers for this payload.
applicability: ruby applications that decode cookies, jobs, or cache values with Marshal.
risk: Remote code execution through object injection; HIGH severity.
